title: Prijetnje, akteri i vektori napada
summary: Threat intelligence i feedovi, CVE i CVSS, prioritizacija ranjivosti, akteri prijetnji i njihove motivacije, te svi vektori napada od e-maila i QR kodova do supply chaina i signala.
summary_en: Threat intelligence and feeds, CVE and CVSS, vulnerability prioritization, threat actors and their motivations, and every attack vector from email and QR codes to the supply chain and signals.
